analysis.comparison: Both decode once and measure LUFS/true peak plus left-aligned s32le SHA256. Native additionally computes QC metrics. FFmpeg baseline excludes FFprobe and backend meter overhead. True-peak filters differ. With --fingerprint both downmix/resample; native retains <=90s windows and emits JSON, FFmpeg emits a continuous raw tap discarded here without backend retention cost. Resamplers are versioned and not bit-identical.

normalization.comparison: Both source decode/hash/FLAC encode and output decode/hash are timed. Native also includes fsync and no-clobber publication. FFmpeg excludes separate probe and backend overhead. Adaptive LPC/Rice or verified FLAC frame-copy can produce different sizes; sizes are reported. FFmpeg verification is a separate subprocess: sum CPU/wall, maximum child RSS. Native independent FFmpeg verification is outside timing.
